thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] HIGH cont-batch timeouts + KV cache growth in us-east-1. contbatch_timeouts=12% over 5m, KV pool cont-batch-gpu-pool-3 showing rapid cache growth (>300GB). Triggered at 2765554321.

evan_oncall: ack — taking this. pinging runtime and sres.

evan_oncall: @maya can you grab runtime? looks like paging thrash + kvcache amplification. re-routing some prod traffic to fallback pools now.

maya: on it. pulling logs now. quick scan shows a deploy earlier today bumped max_num_seqs and max_batch_tokens for cont pools. that could explain very large batches and eviction storms.

tom: seeing repeated OOM lines in kvcache-manager on host i-0a1b2c3d: "oom_killer: kvcache-manager out-of-memory" and then rapid reconnects. also lots of repeated eviction logs.

maya: hypothesis: config change -> oversized batches -> eviction amplification -> cache growth -> paging thrash -> timeouts. mitigation plan: 1) temp reduce max_num_seqs, 2) reduce max_batch_tokens, 3) force more aggressive eviction.

evan_oncall: do it. we need <5m fix.

maya: issuing patch now (curl snippet):
```
curl -X PATCH https://config.internal/api/v1/pools/cont-batch-gpu-pool-3 \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"max_num_seqs":12,"max_batch_tokens":32768,"kvcache_eviction_ratio":0.5}'
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout of config patch to cont-batch-gpu-pool-3 (5 nodes) — initiated by evan_oncall at 2765554410.

liam: storage team looped in — will watch KV shard compaction and free-list growth.

cs_jess: customer-facing note: two enterprise customers reported increased 5xx/timeouts for embeddings and chat flows. telling them we're mitigating and will follow up w/ timeline. any estimate on recovery?

evan_oncall: patch rolling; watch windows 2m. if no improvement we'll scale down contpool and route to dedicated until stable.

maya: logs excerpt: 
```
2026-04-12T15:12:34Z kvcache INFO eviction loop: write_amplification=7.9 free_space=-12GB pool=cont-batch-gpu-pool-3
2026-04-12T15:12:35Z contbatch WARN first_token_latency=3.2s seq_len=28000 batch_tokens=98000
2026-04-12T15:12:36Z kvcache ERROR eviction fail: unable to reclaim pages, retrying
```

maya: :hourglass_flowing_sand: patch is 3/5 applied. monitoring metrics.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 5/5 patched at 2765554510.

evan_oncall: initial signal looks good — contbatch_timeouts down to ~3% and KV cache size trending down over last 3m. tailing p95 latency improving.

tom: one host still thrashing (i-0a1b2c3d), I'll cordon and restart kvcache-manager on that node. proceeding.

liam: kicked off background compaction job (compactor id=comp-9ef3). estimated free ~20-30m but will speed up now after eviction threshold change.

cs_jess: customer A confirmed latency drops from ~12s -> ~400ms. they requested a brief engineering summary; we've assured them root cause mitigations in progress.

maya: immediate follow-ups I'm recording:
- revert accidental config bump in deploy pipeline (max_num_seqs > 24)
- add server-side guardrail to reject max_num_seqs > 24 for cont pools
- add alert for kvcache_eviction_ratio > 0.4 and for sudden KV size growth > 50GB/10m
- add runbook step to scale down max_batch_tokens to safe defaults on surge

evan_oncall: handing incident to eng-runtime for postmortem + permanent fix. @maya you're lead for remediation. i'll stay on for the CS sync.

maya: ack — opening a ticket now and will draft postmortem. thanks everyone for quick triage.

tom: action item for SREs: validate restart behavior doesn't cause double-eviction loops; add graceful backoff on compactor.

liam: will follow up on compaction progress and provide ETA to cs_jess.

cs_jess: putting note in customer tracker, will send update in 10m. thanks.

maya: final note before handoff — root cause appears to be a combination of an unchecked deploy change + insufficient guardrails on cont-batch config. mitigated by reducing batch/window sizes + eviction tuning. next steps: postmortem, pipeline guard, metric alerting, and timelined rollback of the deploy change. closing thread for live mitigation at 2765556123. :white_check_mark:
